name: Heterogeneous Volumes (HV) / Sparse Volume Textures (SVT) approach
definition: Chunking large volumetric datasets into volume textures smaller than one gigavoxel to fit engine limits, then rendering them as a Heterogeneous Volume.
summary: The Heterogeneous Volumes approach renders massive sparse datasets by chunking them into multiple Sparse Volume Textures, bypassing single-texture allocation limits to display large volumes at reasonable frame rates.
